explanation: Both scripts descend from the ancient Aramaic alphabet and mainly write consonants. Many Arabic letters share a basic shape and are told apart only by dots.

claims.text: The Hebrew and Arabic scripts both descend from the Aramaic alphabet.
Hebrew and Arabic are written mainly with consonant letters, with vowel marks optional.
Many Arabic letters share a basic shape and are distinguished only by dots.
